profile.reading: QTS Data Centers, formerly QTS Realty Trust, is a large scale data center provider. Per Blackstone Real Estate Income Trusts own press release, Blackstone affiliated funds completed a roughly 10 billion dollar acquisition of QTS Realty Trust on August 31, 2021, taking the company private. This specific row, QTS Suwanee, matches a DataCenterMap listing specifically for the Suwanee 1 campus as a whole, fetched fresh this session, giving 300 Satellite Blvd NW, Suwanee, Georgia 30024, described as the primary address encompassing both DC1 and DC2 buildings within the 53 acre property, distinct from a separately addressed DC2 sub-listing found by some aggregators at a different Satellite Boulevard house number.
profile.capacity_note: Part of QTS Suwanee, a 53 acre campus with 50+ MW critical campus capacity (100+ MW planned) (per operators own site); campus total, not per-building.
